name: First Term
notes: The initial Assembly is seated using the founding party assignment rather than a popular election (World Bible §12).
Whether four or six founding parties are used depends on final participation: six with forty or more players, otherwise four (§13). The variant will be recorded here once confirmed.
One real month represents ten years of simulated history. Every action carries both a real deadline and a simulated effective date.

name: Second Term
notes: Seats for the Second Term are determined by the general election held between terms, effective from Week 1.
The Interim Charter expires in 2060, after two ten-year terms. A permanent charter must be adopted by two-thirds before expiry (§11).
Assembly size may exceed 600 if constituency overhang arises; the figure shown is the base size.
